description: Define a term from the takefridayoff.com glossary of Australian supplement, food and cosmetic regulation (ARTG, AUST L, sponsor, permitted indications, TGO 116, GMP, FSANZ, AICIS and more): its other names, the definition, its link, the guide section that covers it in depth and the related terms. Finds a term by its name, an abbreviation or its long form; without a term, lists them all.

term.description: The term, abbreviation or long form: "AUST L", "Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods", "MOQ", "TGO 116". Leave out to list every term.

name: tfo_define
title: Define a regulatory term
